run_f_gold: run f_gold to rearrange an array alternating positive and negative numbers in place
test_f_gold: test f_gold against filled implementation using the provided parameter sets and compare results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to alternate positive and negative numbers using a different partitioning strategy
review_f_gold: review f_gold which partitions negatives first then alternates them with positives via swaps
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold algorithm that rearranges array elements to alternate negative and positive values
